events.title: Kwalee Enters the Chat
events.summary: It’s been a little while since you last heard from me here. I only just got out.That’s right: Ballistic.exe has a publisher! Welcome Kwalee, who’ll be helping me with QA, marketing, and all the other things needed to bring a successful game to the world in 202X. Development is going full steam ahead with many exciting things to show you soon.You’ll see some new names and faces on Discord and social media, but I’ll still be posting and hanging out in the community for my allotted daily recreation

events.title: The big jump
events.summary: Well, this is it: As of last monday, I quit my job and I am now working on Ballistic.exe full time!It feels great to switch from daily to hourly commits, and spend time with my daughter on evenings instead of working all night.Still, it is as scary as it is exciting! But we are now nearing 30k wishlists, and this move doesn't feel as incredibly foolish as it did only a year ago.Still, I thank you every time you share the game or help grow the community in any way, we wouldn't be here without you
